lines: Yuri and Kanzaki Juubei had finally arrived at their destination of Yomihara.
He had said a meeting of underworld organizations was to be held here today.
「You've arrived, I see. I've been waiting.」
Supposedly, she had summoned Juubei here.
She was a tall woman with light-chestnut-coloured hair.
With a slender face and narrow eyes, she was the very image of a beauty.
But, like Yuri, her calm demeanour had a cold quality to it, characteristic of someone who lived in the criminal underworld.
Juubei greeted that unmistakably shrewd woman with casual familiarity.
His gesture of flashing her a peace sign and grinning at just the right angle was like a scene out of a movie.
Yuri had learned this on the journey here, but these kind of theatrics seemed to be his style.
It was a little too much for her to take, though.
It looked like Kaworu concurred, as she was making a wry smile immediately after meeting him.
「It's a load off my mind to see the Boss hasn't changed either. I was kinda worried.」
「My, did something happen that would make you worried about me?」
「Oi oi, I heard all about it. He pulled a fast one on you, didn't he, Boss?」
Juubei said suggestively, and she frowned slightly.
「Always the first to hear about everything, huh? I just let my guard down for a moment. Besides, I didn't get to meet him in person.」
「Heh, is that so? I met him for the first time in a while not too long ago. He's turned out pretty good-lookin'.」
「I'll look forward to seeing that, then. Ufufu.」
「Whoa, scary, scary. That guy's got it pretty rough, huh?」
「Then, why don't you go back over to him?」
「This is one thing, that's another. The Boss feels the same way, right?」
The two of them were getting excited about something.
Yuri was listening silently, since the topic was someone she didn't know.
「Whoops, I was gettin' carried away all on my own, huh? My bad, my bad.」
「You're going to introduce me at last, then? I've been curious all this time.」
「Pleased to meet you. Is she your secretary? Or your girlfriend?」
「She's my escort. They say good company makes the road shorter, after all, yeah?」
Kaworu gazed at her like she wanted to say something.

Her demeanour suggested that, on top of having discerned at a glance that she was a two-sword user, she had also sensed that Yuri was the assassin known in underworld circles as the 『Snow Enchantress』.
However, without mentioning any of that out loud, she turned to Juubei and said,
「Anyway, I'm shocked. To think that the boss of Senzaki would turn up with just one bodyguard.」
（Boss of Senzaki? This person was that much of a bigshot? He's certainly highly skilled, but......）
Paying no attention to Yuri, who was inwardly surprised, he shrugged his shoulders exaggeratedly.
「I wasn't gonna come, if it weren't for the Boss's invitation. So today's what you'd call a personal visit.」
「I do love that sense of duty of yours.」
「So? Are the people we're meeting here yet?」
While faintly smiling, Kaworu shifted her eyes to the back of the room.
Enticed by that, Yuri looked, and the other meeting attendees were coming along one after another.
Inhabitants of the underworld. They all looked like they had a quirk or two.
Clone Asagi, her freeloading trio of a detective team, and Kiryuu Mikoto were in the Yomihara sewers.
「Whoooaaa!! What a smell. It's enough to make your nose curl, isn't it?!」
「But this smell sure is kinda harsh. And there's some other weird smell mixed in with the sewer. You okay, Nasara-chan?」
「Okay...... Sewer...... Place where rainwater and wastewater collect...... Cesspool. Very interesting.」
「Aww, man, Nasara-chan is really adorable, always filled with curiosity. I'm gonna give her a biiig～ squeeze!!」
「Hey, Otherworld Creature. You've got way too much indiscriminate curiosity over everything.」
「That's fine, isn't it? Hey, Nasara-chan? Look, squishy cheeks～～♪」
「And this one goes and showers affection indiscriminately too. Sheesh, (grumble-grumble)......」
「If you chat too much here, a pesky Devil Worm or something is going to show up. So quiet down a little, all right?」
「That's not an issue. I made sure to bring a scent ball.」
「It emits a smell that demonic beasts don't like. Those things won't come near us with this.」
「Tell us that sort of thing ahead of time. Still, I've never heard that something like that existed before.」
「I've learned of it recently myself. It was apparently in some old book.」
「Ungh, is that why there's been a weird smell coming from you for the last little while?」
「Apologies for that. It's better than meeting face-to-face with a swarm of Devil Worms, right?」
「That's for sure. Besides, we don't wanna have any unnecessary fights before the raid, do we?」
「It's an infiltration, not a raid. Just to be clear.」
Clone Asagi sighed internally at Aki, who was raring to fight from the get-go.
Although, it was understandable, considering that she was a Taimanin.
Kiryuu Mikoto's commission was to infiltrate a certain research facility in Yomihara.
It seemed that “Secret Service Agency G”, an organization affiliated with the UFS State Department, had built it in collaboration with succubus forces.
There, she said, priceless Demon World goods were being supplied to Secret Service Agency G by the succubi, and they were developing something together.
As far as Aki, the Taimanin, was concerned, that point was more than enough reason to annihilate it.
Of course, Mikoto, the Mad Scientist, was hardly going to have such pure motives.
She was just trying to steal the goods developed at the research facility, to use as materials for her own experiments.
Her request for Clone Asagi was, in other words, to assist in that theft.
It was the kind of job that Clone Asagi would normally refuse, but for her, this was not somebody else's problem.
The enemy was her old home, Secret Service Agency G. If they established something like a research base in Yomihara, all sorts of problems would spring up thereafter.
Setting aside whether or not they could destroy it, there was no harm in at least disrupting their research.
That was the reason she had taken on the job.
It seemed like this would undoubtedly develop into a battle, so she had told the freeloader trio, “Participation is optional,” yet nobody had tried to go home.
『I'm a Taimanin, after all, right? Plus, it's thanks for you looking after me all the time.』
『Ha ha ha, I wanna see the worthless research data from that “Secret Service Agency G”, or whatever. And, well... What the hell. I'll do it for you.』
『Asagi's cooking... yummy... Want to eat... more... Funding... necessary...』
（Well, there's no doubt they can be relied on, huh?）
While she was thinking things like that, they were all walking along as a group, when Mikoto suddenly stopped in her tracks.
「How are we gonna get in? Far as I can see, there's nothing that looks like an entrance anywhere.」
「Other side of wall... confirmed... hollow... Artificial subterranean space.」
「That's the shape of it. The rest is simple. We just have to make one♪」
Mikoto smiled, and took a quick draw stance, facing the wall.
Upon closer inspection, ominous miasma was emanating from her “Demon God Arm”.
Without even needing to be told, everyone took their distance to escape the miasma.
A single flash of her sword.
The miasma-clad slash shattered the solid wall like it was tofu.
When Mikoto sheathed her sword, the wall had collapsed extensively, opening a passage to a room that looked to be the building's basement.
The whole group snuck through the hole she had opened, and into the basement of the enemy facility.
「I did sense a terrible magical power. If you've got that Demon God Arm thing, you'd've been fine on your own, wouldn't you?」
「Controlling this arm is tricky. After what I just did, I won't be able to use it for a while.」
「Right. I'll leave the rest to you♪」
She was about to step back, as if to say that her job was done now, when she jumped.
「Demon God Arm. Very interesting. Show more.」
Nasara was clinging to Mikoto's right arm, looking uncharacteristically excited.
「Let Nasara see. Let Nasara see... arm. Let out... miasma... one more time... One more time!」
「And she's unusually hooked, isn't she? Well, it's only natural. I wanna study it in detail too!」
「Want to know more, show Nasara! Please... Nasara... wants to see... more!」
「Cut it out already! Don't cling to me. Hey, don't! This isn't for show!」
Looking annoyed, Mikoto held her arm up high, so as not to let Nasara touch it.
「Bad, that's bad! Want to know... more! Let her see... arm! Nasara... wants to know... Wants new knowledge!」
Nasara was hopping up and down to try and touch Mikoto's arm, but it looked like their heights were too different for her to reach.
It would be easy to extend a tentacle from her body, but she was so excited that she was even forgetting about that.
「Nasara... wants... that. Please give it... Please give her... Demon God Arm!」
「Give it to you? Hold on! There's no way I could give it to you, is there?!」
「Kuuuu!! Nasara-chan, bursting with curiosity at new prey! How cute, way too cuuute!」
「Hmm. Now she's gotten like this, there's no stopping her anymore.」
「Hey! Don't just have fun over there! Asagi, do something about this kid!!」
Clone Asagi took out the trump card she had prepared for times like this.
She spun her face around to Clone Asagi, and then immediately
Did a big hop towards her, and held out her hands with a smile across her whole face.
「It has chocolate chips in it today.」
「First time... with chocolate chips in... Grateful. (Munch)... Yummy... (Munch-munch), yummy. Nasara's... happy... Loves... Asagi's snacks...」
Clone Asagi was making a wry smile.
She was always carrying around homemade snacks, to prevent Nasara running wild when she took an interest in something strange.
Of course, their food expenses were piling up because of that.
「That's 'cause she's an extradimensional being whose raison d'être is accumulating new knowledge. You're best off not showing her anything too unusual.」
「Well then, shall we go? Nasara, make sure not to spill crumbs, all right?」
While quietly eating her cookie (and letting crumbs spill from her mouth even though she had been warned), Nasara followed along after Asagi.
After a short while, the group emerged in a vast room which seemed to be an underground factory.
「Fufufu, here we go, here we go! As I thought, they're hoarding all sorts of stuff. Sooo～ many precious Demon World commodities...」
「Kyaah, no way! Black mandrake that's been uprooted by hellhounds, in this day and age? Do you have any idea how valuable this is?!」
「One, two, three... No way, there are four of them! I've just got to bring these back with me.」
It looked like this was the target location.
Now, not Nasara, but Mikoto's eyes were glittering brightly.
While darting her eyes this way and that, she began to ransack the storeroom.
「Hmph, a passable assortment. It's not bad, for a research facility by stupid humans.」
「Mmmm, what is this?! Isn't this charred leg of haggis? I can't believe it. Where'd they get their hands on this?」
「Whoa?! Banana gin? There's no way something like this exists! How'd they extract it?!」
The witch, Miriam, had also been looking around cynically, but before she knew it, she was starting to get excited too.
「Is Nasara-chan okay? Looks like there's a ton of precious goods here.」
「Nasara's... not interested... just because... it's rare...」
「Shall we leave collecting the goods to those two, and guard the perimeter, say?」
「If they're making such a racket, someone's bound to turn up, right? How about Nasara-chan......? Huh?」
Aki was about to ask Nasara, when she started to wander off.
「I wonder if there's something she's interested in?」
While cocking their heads in confusion, Clone Asagi and Aki split up and began guarding the perimeter.
Incidentally, it wasn't just Nasara who was wandering around the factory.
Since its master was absorbed in treasure hunting, it had gotten bored and started having a stroll.
This same Kuro had previously been kidnapped by a shady organization, and even though it seemed more docile compared to Shiro, it was highly curious.
For that reason, it often caused trouble for its master,
And it seemed the pattern was holding this time, too.
In front of where Kuro was flying around, a security drone appeared, which was common in this kind of facility.
The security drone pointed the barrel of its gun at it.
Kuro just flapped its wings in terror.
Then, a girl blocked the way in front of it.
This was a scene it had witnessed sometime before.
But things were different from back then.
Tentacles extended from her and pulverized the security drone in a single blow.
Kuro made a happy-sounding chirp, but the fact that a security drone had appeared meant that their infiltration had been detected.
And due to the fact that she had destroyed one, new security drones began to gather one after another.
